# Preserva Wellness

> Preserva Wellness is an Ayurvedic natural wellness brand specializing in curcumin-based herbal supplements, juices, and teas for targeted health conditions.

The site offers a comprehensive catalog of Ayurvedic products organized by health needs, including immunity boosting, digestive health, respiratory support, cardiovascular wellness, and metabolic health. All products feature natural ingredients like turmeric, curcumin, tulsi, and aloe vera formulated according to traditional Ayurvedic principles.
